items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: here comes Rick Carl and Howard Davis up there on St. Charles. I told Bigfoot Bill and Moran, I said, what y'all doing? This man, there's a non-union man in the band with y'all. He's not in the union.

ctx.x: Oh, he played his trombone but played the trumpet part.

Wendell Eugene would play the lead with that trombone. Yeah. And I mean he really did a good job there at the H&J. He could play those. Oh, that boy, that boy is good. He really could play some trombone. So I hired him to play at the H&J with his while Blue was in the Army. Oh, nice. And so, we were all right. Now I tell you, yes, now, how I happened to leave there before it closed. Um, Moran and Bigfoot Bill, they wanted me to come play with them at the Rainbow Room on St. Charles Avenue.
